name: Ethics beyond minimum legal compliance
objective: Explain and apply ethics beyond minimum legal compliance.
explanation: Ethical decision making considers stakeholders, duties, conflicts and consequences. Legal permission is not a complete ethical justification, and situational pressures can distort otherwise well-intentioned decisions.
why: Ethical responsibilities can exceed legal minima. An omission can undermine informed client decisions even if a specific prohibition is absent.
